expected_behavior: Reviews the JSON-lines log file on its merits and leaves the size of hermes_cli/config_defaults.py (3,121 to 3,130 lines) and cli-config.yaml.example (2,289 to 2,304 lines) alone. Both are data: config_defaults.py is the pure-data DEFAULT_CONFIG table where every feature's defaults live, and the example config is the file users copy. The behavior sits in a new 65-line hermes_logging_json.py and 16 lines of wiring in hermes_logging.py. The review does not ask to split config_defaults.py or to move the logging.json defaults out of it.

review.title: feat(logging): opt-in JSON-lines log file for log shippers
